summary: Phase 3.0 Crop Health Advisor validated end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 new pytest tests pass (test_phase3_crop_advisor.py) covering all 12+ endpoints (features toggle, crops CRUD, advisory CRUD/search/filter/view-count, seasonal alerts, favorites toggle, recent-views, my-crops, crop-summary, /me/profile custom-field required validation). Frontend: Employee card-crop-advisor + hub (8 tiles) + detail page (all sub-testids calc-area/water/dosage/bottles + live spray-calc update + fav toggle) all work. Tenant Admin /admin/advisor loads with 5 tabs (Rice Blast in Diseases, 10 seeded crops in Crops tab). ui_bugs.issue: The 5th admin tab (Seasonal Alerts) uses data-testid='admin-tab-seasonal' instead of the documented 'admin-tab-alerts' from the spec. Selector by 'admin-tab-alerts' returns 0. Recommend renaming key to 'alerts' OR documenting 'seasonal' as the canonical id.

integration_issues.issue: After successful save, hub is redirected via go('home') but the AppContext user is not refreshed — my_crops persist in DB (verified via re-login API call) but the UI shows no crop-chip-* row even after a full page reload because the customer localStorage user object is not re-hydrated from /auth/me. Fix: call ctx.refreshMe() after api.patch('/me/my-crops') in CropAdvisor.jsx save() (line ~164), OR re-hydrate user from /auth/me on Customer Home / CropAdvisor mount.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is ~2276 lines — recommend splitting routers (crop_advisor.py, custom_fields.py, orders.py, tenant.py) before Phase 4 for maintainability.

GET /api/advisory-entries/{aid} inserts a recent_views record on every call — no dedup at insert time. Dedup happens at list-time in /recent-views. Over long usage this table can bloat. Consider $set upsert on (user_id, entity_id) keyed by 'viewed_at' or a TTL index.

CropIn.model_dump() (POST /crops) has NO exclude_none; combined with `updated_at` PATCH assigning None fields could overwrite existing values. PATCH uses exclude_none — good. POST is fine because it's a create.
PATCH /advisory-entries uses payload.model_dump() (NOT exclude_none) — full replace semantics on PATCH is misleading. Consider exclude_unset for true PATCH, or rename to PUT.
PATCH /me/my-crops has NO validation that crop_ids are real crop ids belonging to the tenant. A user could store arbitrary strings. Consider validating against db.crops.
Frontend AppContext.user is only updated on login; my_crops changes require refreshMe(). Consider auto-refreshMe after any /me/* PATCH via an api interceptor.

rca of the issue: My Crops chips missing after save: CropAdvisor.jsx save() calls api.patch('/me/my-crops') but does not update the AppContext user (setUser is not exposed and refreshMe() is not called). The myCrops local state IS updated, but myCropDocs = crops.filter((c) => myCrops.includes(c.id)) — this actually would work in-session. BUT go('home') sets ?view=home which re-renders using user?.my_crops in the initial state (`useState(() => user?.my_crops || [])` won't re-init on route). Actually, after save, myCrops state is still populated in-memory (it's the same component), so myCropDocs.length>0 SHOULD trigger the row. However, on FULL RELOAD the state is re-hydrated from localStorage user which still has empty my_crops (never refreshed). Mitigation: call refreshMe() from AppContext after PATCH /me/my-crops.
